resources.string: Note that Bing search is crawler-based, which may be unstable and is not recommended.

Free keyless search router. Firecrawl Keyless is the primary web/news/image search and markdown scrape backend (no Firecrawl API key). Other sources: Open-Meteo, wttr.in, Google News, Qwant, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Wikimedia Commons, and Wikipedia (encyclopedia only). Rate limits fall through automatically.
